regions.note: Basque framework only: each public centre's Consejo Escolar approves its own calendar (proposal before 01-06-2026), within these limits; centres that fail get a calendar 'de oficio' from the Delegación Territorial, but no separate territorial calendars for Araba/Bizkaia/Gipuzkoa were found published. Breaks are MINIMUM periods ('incluirán al menos'); centres may extend them (e.g., Carnavales is mentioned but not dated). Holidays: official CAPV labour holidays plus local and territorial patron days (e.g., territorial holidays differ by province) are non-lective; centres may declare the level's patron day. Start/end are bounds, not fixed dates, hence nulls. Private/concertado centres follow the Orden de 10-03-2008 (texto refundido) but these resolutions cover public centres. Separate resolutions exist for conservatorios, Dantzerti, ID Arte, Kirolene and CIFP (not read).
